text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear position with \"Although... there are many more advantages\"","quality":"stance clarity","description":"It states a definite argument and keeps the writer's position clear throughout the essay."},{"evidence":"paragraphs weighing \"cons\" and \"pros\"","quality":"organization","description":"It has a more developed structure that separates the introduction, counterargument, support, and conclusion."},{"evidence":"references to fault, initial cost, fuel, safety sensors, and entertainment systems","quality":"evidence use","description":"It uses multiple relevant details from the source article to support its claims."},{"evidence":"\"If the technology fails... who is at fault?\" and \"There are some unanswered questions\"","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"It acknowledges objections and responds to them rather than only listing one side."},{"evidence":"\"All in all\" and repeated restatement of the main claim","quality":"conclusion development","description":"It ends with a fuller conclusion that restates and reinforces the argument."}]}
